1→import { next as Automerge, Heads } from "@automerge/automerge/slim"
     2→import debug from "debug"
     3→import { EventEmitter } from "eventemitter3"
     4→import {
     5→  binaryToDocumentId,
     6→  encodeHeads,
     7→  generateAutomergeUrl,
     8→  interpretAsDocumentId,
     9→  isValidAutomergeUrl,
    10→  parseAutomergeUrl,
    11→} from "./AutomergeUrl.js"
    12→import {
    13→  DELETED,
    14→  DocHandle,
    15→  DocHandleEncodedChangePayload,
    16→  READY,
    17→  UNAVAILABLE,
    18→  UNLOADED,
    19→} from "./DocHandle.js"
    20→import { RemoteHeadsSubscriptions } from "./RemoteHeadsSubscriptions.js"
    21→import { headsAreSame } from "./helpers/headsAreSame.js"
    22→import { throttle } from "./helpers/throttle.js"
    23→import {
    24→  NetworkAdapterInterface,
    25→  type PeerMetadata,
    26→} from "./network/NetworkAdapterInterface.js"
    27→import { NetworkSubsystem } from "./network/NetworkSubsystem.js"
    28→import { RepoMessage } from "./network/messages.js"
    29→import { StorageAdapterInterface } from "./storage/StorageAdapterInterface.js"
    30→import { StorageSubsystem } from "./storage/StorageSubsystem.js"
    31→import { StorageId } from "./storage/types.js"
    32→import { CollectionSynchronizer } from "./synchronizer/CollectionSynchronizer.js"
    33→import {
    34→  DocSyncMetrics,
    35→  SyncStatePayload,
    36→} from "./synchronizer/Synchronizer.js"
    37→import type {
    38→  AnyDocumentId,
    39→  AutomergeUrl,
    40→  BinaryDocumentId,
    41→  DocumentId,
    42→  PeerId,
    43→} from "./types.js"
    44→import { abortable, AbortOptions, AbortError } from "./helpers/abortable.js"
    45→import { FindProgress } from "./FindProgress.js"
    46→
    47→export type FindProgressWithMethods<T> = FindProgress<T> & {
    48→  untilReady: (allowableStates: string[]) => Promise<DocHandle<T>>
    49→  peek: () => FindProgress<T>
    50→  subscribe: (callback: (progress: FindProgress<T>) => void) => () => void
    51→}
    52→
    53→export type ProgressSignal<T> = {
    54→  peek: () => FindProgress<T>
    55→  subscribe: (callback: (progress: FindProgress<T>) => void) => () => void
    56→  untilReady: (allowableStates: string[]) => Promise<DocHandle<T>>
    57→}
    58→
    59→function randomPeerId() {
    60→  return ("peer-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(4)) as PeerId
    61→}
    62→
    63→/** A Repo is a collection of documents with networking, syncing, and storage capabilities. */
    64→/** The `Repo` is the main entry point of this library
    65→ *
    66→ * @remarks
    67→ * To construct a `Repo` you will need an {@link StorageAdapter} and one or
    68→ * more {@link NetworkAdapter}s. Once you have a `Repo` you can use it to
    69→ * obtain {@link DocHandle}s.
    70→ */
    71→export class Repo extends EventEmitter<RepoEvents> {
    72→  #log: debug.Debugger
    73→
    74→  /** @hidden */
    75→  networkSubsystem: NetworkSubsystem
    76→  /** @hidden */
    77→  storageSubsystem?: StorageSubsystem
    78→
    79→  /** @hidden */
    80→  #saveDebounceRate: number
    81→
    82→  /** @hidden */
    83→  #saveFn: (payload: DocHandleEncodedChangePayload<any>) => void
    84→
    85→  #handleCache: Record<DocumentId, DocHandle<any>> = {}
    86→
    87→  /** @hidden */
    88→  synchronizer: CollectionSynchronizer
    89→
    90→  #shareConfig: ShareConfig = {
    91→    announce: async () => true,
    92→    access: async () => true,
    93→  }
    94→
    95→  /** maps peer id to to persistence information (storageId, isEphemeral), access by collection synchronizer  */
    96→  /** @hidden */
    97→  peerMetadataByPeerId: Record<PeerId, PeerMetadata> = {}
    98→
    99→  #remoteHeadsSubscriptions = new RemoteHeadsSubscriptions()
   100→  #remoteHeadsGossipingEnabled = false
   101→  #progressCache: Record<DocumentId, FindProgress<any>> = {}
   102→  #saveFns: Record<
   103→    DocumentId,
   104→    (payload: DocHandleEncodedChangePayload<any>) => void
   105→  > = {}
   106→  #idFactory: ((initialHeads: Heads) => Promise<Uint8Array>) | null
   107→
   108→  constructor({
   109→    storage,
   110→    network = [],
   111→    peerId = randomPeerId(),
   112→    sharePolicy,
   113→    shareConfig,
   114→    isEphemeral = storage === undefined,
   115→    enableRemoteHeadsGossiping = false,
   116→    denylist = [],
   117→    saveDebounceRate = 100,
   118→    idFactory,
   119→  }: RepoConfig = {}) {
   120→    super()
   121→    this.#remoteHeadsGossipingEnabled = enableRemoteHeadsGossiping
   122→    this.#log = debug(`automerge-repo:repo`)
   123→
   124→    this.#idFactory = idFactory || null
   125→    // Handle legacy sharePolicy
   126→    if (sharePolicy != null && shareConfig != null) {
   127→      throw new Error("cannot provide both sharePolicy and shareConfig at once")
   128→    }
   129→    if (sharePolicy) {
   130→      this.#shareConfig = {
   131→        announce: sharePolicy,
   132→        access: async () => true,
   133→      }
   134→    }
   135→    if (shareConfig) {
   136→      this.#shareConfig = shareConfig
   137→    }
   138→
   139→    this.on("delete-document", ({ documentId }) => {
   140→      this.synchronizer.removeDocument(documentId)
   141→
   142→      if (storageSubsystem) {
   143→        storageSubsystem.removeDoc(documentId).catch(err => {
   144→          this.#log("error deleting document", { documentId, err })
   145→        })
   146→      }
   147→    })
   148→
   149→    // SYNCHRONIZER
   150→    // The synchronizer uses the network subsystem to keep documents in sync with peers.
   151→    this.synchronizer = new CollectionSynchronizer(this, denylist)
   152→
   153→    // When the synchronizer emits messages, send them to peers
   154→    this.synchronizer.on("message", message => {
   155→      this.#log(`sending ${message.type} message to ${message.targetId}`)
   156→      networkSubsystem.send(message)
   157→    })
   158→
   159→    // Forward metrics from doc synchronizers
   160→    this.synchronizer.on("metrics", event => this.emit("doc-metrics", event))
   161→
   162→    if (this.#remoteHeadsGossipingEnabled) {
   163→      this.synchronizer.on("open-doc", ({ peerId, documentId }) => {
   164→        this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.subscribePeerToDoc(peerId, documentId)
   165→      })
   166→    }
   167→
   168→    // STORAGE
   169→    // The storage subsystem has access to some form of persistence, and deals with save and loading documents.
   170→    const storageSubsystem = storage ? new StorageSubsystem(storage) : undefined
   171→    if (storageSubsystem) {
   172→      storageSubsystem.on("document-loaded", event =>
   173→        this.emit("doc-metrics", { type: "doc-loaded", ...event })
   174→      )
   175→      storageSubsystem.on("doc-compacted", event =>
   176→        this.emit("doc-metrics", { type: "doc-compacted", ...event })
   177→      )
   178→      storageSubsystem.on("doc-saved", event =>
   179→        this.emit("doc-metrics", { type: "doc-saved", ...event })
   180→      )
   181→    }
   182→
   183→    this.storageSubsystem = storageSubsystem
   184→
   185→    this.#saveDebounceRate = saveDebounceRate
   186→
   187→    if (this.storageSubsystem) {
   188→      // Save no more often than saveDebounceRate.
   189→      this.#saveFn = ({ handle, doc }: DocHandleEncodedChangePayload<any>) => {
   190→        let fn = this.#saveFns[handle.documentId]
   191→        if (!fn) {
   192→          fn = throttle(
   193→            ({ doc, handle }: DocHandleEncodedChangePayload<any>) => {
   194→              void this.storageSubsystem!.saveDoc(handle.documentId, doc)
   195→            },
   196→            this.#saveDebounceRate
   197→          )
   198→          this.#saveFns[handle.documentId] = fn
   199→        }
   200→        fn({ handle, doc })
   201→      }
   202→    } else {
   203→      this.#saveFn = () => {}
   204→    }
   205→
   206→    // NETWORK
   207→    // The network subsystem deals with sending and receiving messages to and from peers.
   208→
   209→    const myPeerMetadata: Promise<PeerMetadata> = (async () => ({
   210→      storageId: await storageSubsystem?.id(),
   211→      isEphemeral,
   212→    }))()
   213→
   214→    const networkSubsystem = new NetworkSubsystem(
   215→      network,
   216→      peerId,
   217→      myPeerMetadata
   218→    )
   219→    this.networkSubsystem = networkSubsystem
   220→
   221→    // When we get a new peer, register it with the synchronizer
   222→    networkSubsystem.on("peer", async ({ peerId, peerMetadata }) => {
   223→      this.#log("peer connected", { peerId })
   224→
   225→      if (peerMetadata) {
   226→        this.peerMetadataByPeerId[peerId] = { ...peerMetadata }
   227→      }
   228→
   229→      this.#shareConfig
   230→        .announce(peerId)
   231→        .then(shouldShare => {
   232→          if (shouldShare && this.#remoteHeadsGossipingEnabled) {
   233→            this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.addGenerousPeer(peerId)
   234→          }
   235→        })
   236→        .catch(err => {
   237→          console.log("error in share policy", { err })
   238→        })
   239→
   240→      this.synchronizer.addPeer(peerId)
   241→    })
   242→
   243→    // When a peer disconnects, remove it from the synchronizer
   244→    networkSubsystem.on("peer-disconnected", ({ peerId }) => {
   245→      this.synchronizer.removePeer(peerId)
   246→      this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.removePeer(peerId)
   247→    })
   248→
   249→    // Handle incoming messages
   250→    networkSubsystem.on("message", async msg => {
   251→      this.#receiveMessage(msg)
   252→    })
   253→
   254→    this.synchronizer.on("sync-state", message => {
   255→      this.#saveSyncState(message)
   256→
   257→      const handle = this.#handleCache[message.documentId]
   258→
   259→      const { storageId } = this.peerMetadataByPeerId[message.peerId] || {}
   260→      if (!storageId) {
   261→        return
   262→      }
   263→
   264→      const heads = handle.getSyncInfo(storageId)?.lastHeads
   265→      const haveHeadsChanged =
   266→        message.syncState.theirHeads &&
   267→        (!heads ||
   268→          !headsAreSame(heads, encodeHeads(message.syncState.theirHeads)))
   269→
   270→      if (haveHeadsChanged && message.syncState.theirHeads) {
   271→        handle.setSyncInfo(storageId, {
   272→          lastHeads: encodeHeads(message.syncState.theirHeads),
   273→          lastSyncTimestamp: Date.now(),
   274→        })
   275→
   276→        if (storageId && this.#remoteHeadsGossipingEnabled) {
   277→          this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.handleImmediateRemoteHeadsChanged(
   278→            message.documentId,
   279→            storageId,
   280→            encodeHeads(message.syncState.theirHeads)
   281→          )
   282→        }
   283→      }
   284→    })
   285→
   286→    if (this.#remoteHeadsGossipingEnabled) {
   287→      this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.on("notify-remote-heads", message => {
   288→        this.networkSubsystem.send({
   289→          type: "remote-heads-changed",
   290→          targetId: message.targetId,
   291→          documentId: message.documentId,
   292→          newHeads: {
   293→            [message.storageId]: {
   294→              heads: message.heads,
   295→              timestamp: message.timestamp,
   296→            },
   297→          },
   298→        })
   299→      })
   300→
   301→      this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.on("change-remote-subs", message => {
   302→        this.#log("change-remote-subs", message)
   303→        for (const peer of message.peers) {
   304→          this.networkSubsystem.send({
   305→            type: "remote-subscription-change",
   306→            targetId: peer,
   307→            add: message.add,
   308→            remove: message.remove,
   309→          })
   310→        }
   311→      })
   312→
   313→      this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.on(
   314→        "remote-heads-changed",
   315→        ({ documentId, storageId, remoteHeads, timestamp }) => {
   316→          const handle = this.#handleCache[documentId]
   317→          handle.setSyncInfo(storageId, {
   318→            lastHeads: remoteHeads,
   319→            lastSyncTimestamp: timestamp,
   320→          })
   321→        }
   322→      )
   323→    }
   324→  }
   325→
   326→  // The `document` event is fired by the DocCollection any time we create a new document or look
   327→  // up a document by ID. We listen for it in order to wire up storage and network synchronization.
   328→  #registerHandleWithSubsystems(handle: DocHandle<any>) {
   329→    if (this.storageSubsystem) {
   330→      // Add save function as a listener if it's not already registered
   331→      const existingListeners = handle.listeners("heads-changed")
   332→      if (!existingListeners.some(listener => listener === this.#saveFn)) {
   333→        // Save when the document changes
   334→        handle.on("heads-changed", this.#saveFn)
   335→      }
   336→    }
   337→
   338→    // Register the document with the synchronizer. This advertises our interest in the document.
   339→    this.synchronizer.addDocument(handle)
   340→  }
   341→
   342→  #receiveMessage(message: RepoMessage) {
   343→    switch (message.type) {
   344→      case "remote-subscription-change":
   345→        if (this.#remoteHeadsGossipingEnabled) {
   346→          this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.handleControlMessage(message)
   347→        }
   348→        break
   349→      case "remote-heads-changed":
   350→        if (this.#remoteHeadsGossipingEnabled) {
   351→          this.#remoteHeadsSubscriptions.handleRemoteHeads(message)
   352→        }
   353→        break
   354→      case "sync":
   355→      case "request":
   356→      case "ephemeral":
   357→      case "doc-unavailable":
   358→        this.synchronizer.receiveMessage(message).catch(err => {
   359→          console.log("error receiving message", { err, message })
   360→        })
   361→    }
   362→  }
   363→
   364→  #throttledSaveSyncStateHandlers: Record<
   365→    StorageId,
   366→    (payload: SyncStatePayload) => void
   367→  > = {}
   368→
   369→  /** saves sync state throttled per storage id, if a peer doesn't have a storage id it's sync state is not persisted */
   370→  #saveSyncState(payload: SyncStatePayload) {
   371→    if (!this.storageSubsystem) {
   372→      return
   373→    }
   374→
   375→    const { storageId, isEphemeral } =
   376→      this.peerMetadataByPeerId[payload.peerId] || {}
   377→
   378→    if (!storageId || isEphemeral) {
   379→      return
   380→    }
   381→
   382→    let handler = this.#throttledSaveSyncStateHandlers[storageId]
   383→    if (!handler) {
   384→      handler = this.#throttledSaveSyncStateHandlers[storageId] = throttle(
   385→        ({ documentId, syncState }: SyncStatePayload) => {
   386→          void this.storageSubsystem!.saveSyncState(
   387→            documentId,
   388→            storageId,
   389→            syncState
   390→          )
   391→        },
   392→        this.#saveDebounceRate
   393→      )
   394→    }
   395→
   396→    handler(payload)
   397→  }
   398→
   399→  /** Returns an existing handle if we have it; creates one otherwise. */
   400→  #getHandle<T>({
   401→    documentId,
   402→  }: {
   403→    /** The documentId of the handle to look up or create */
   404→    documentId: DocumentId /** If we know we're creating a new document, specify this so we can have access to it immediately */
   405→  }) {
   406→    // If we have the handle cached, return it
   407→    if (this.#handleCache[documentId]) return this.#handleCache[documentId]
   408→
   409→    // If not, create a new handle, cache it, and return it
   410→    if (!documentId) throw new Error(`Invalid documentId ${documentId}`)
   411→    const handle = new DocHandle<T>(documentId)
   412→    this.#handleCache[documentId] = handle
   413→    return handle
   414→  }
   415→
   416→  /** Returns all the handles we have cached. */
   417→  get handles() {
   418→    return this.#handleCache
   419→  }

   454→  /**
   455→   * Creates a new document and returns a handle to it. The initial value of the document is an
   456→   * empty object `{}` unless an initial value is provided. Its documentId is generated by the
   457→   * system. we emit a `document` event to advertise interest in the document.
   458→   */
   459→  create<T>(initialValue?: T): DocHandle<T> {
   460→    let initialDoc: Automerge.Doc<T>
   461→    if (initialValue) {
   462→      initialDoc = Automerge.from(initialValue)
   463→    } else {
   464→      initialDoc = Automerge.emptyChange(Automerge.init())
   465→    }
   466→
   467→    // Generate a new UUID and store it in the buffer
   468→    const { documentId } = parseAutomergeUrl(generateAutomergeUrl())
   469→    const handle = this.#getHandle<T>({
   470→      documentId,
   471→    }) as DocHandle<T>
   472→
   473→    this.#registerHandleWithSubsystems(handle)
   474→
   475→    handle.update(() => {
   476→      return initialDoc
   477→    })
   478→
   479→    handle.doneLoading()
   480→    return handle
   481→  }
   482→
   483→  /**
   484→   * Creates a new document and returns a handle to it. The initial value of the
   485→   * document is an empty object `{}` unless an initial value is provided. The
   486→   * main difference between this and Repo.create is that if an `idGenerator`
   487→   * was provided at repo construction, that idGenerator will be used to
   488→   * generate the document ID of the document returned by this method.
   489→   *
   490→   * This is a hidden, experimental API which is subject to change or removal without notice.
   491→   * @hidden
   492→   * @experimental
   493→   */
   494→  async create2<T>(initialValue?: T): Promise<DocHandle<T>> {
   495→    // Note that the reason this method is hidden and experimental is because it is async,
   496→    // and it is async because we want to be able to call the #idGenerator, which is async.
   497→    // This is all really in service of wiring up keyhive and we probably need to find a
   498→    // nicer way to achieve this.
   499→    let initialDoc: Automerge.Doc<T>
   500→    if (initialValue) {
   501→      initialDoc = Automerge.from(initialValue)
   502→    } else {
   503→      initialDoc = Automerge.emptyChange(Automerge.init())
   504→    }
   505→
   506→    let { documentId } = parseAutomergeUrl(generateAutomergeUrl())
   507→    if (this.#idFactory) {
   508→      const rawDocId = await this.#idFactory(Automerge.getHeads(initialDoc))
   509→      documentId = binaryToDocumentId(rawDocId as BinaryDocumentId)
   510→    }
   511→    const handle = this.#getHandle<T>({
   512→      documentId,
   513→    }) as DocHandle<T>
   514→
   515→    this.#registerHandleWithSubsystems(handle)
   516→
   517→    handle.update(() => {
   518→      return initialDoc
   519→    })
   520→
   521→    handle.doneLoading()
   522→    return handle
   523→  }
   524→  /** Create a new DocHandle by cloning the history of an existing DocHandle.
   525→   *
   526→   * @param clonedHandle - The handle to clone
   527→   *
   528→   * @remarks This is a wrapper around the `clone` function in the Automerge library.
   529→   * The new `DocHandle` will have a new URL but will share history with the original,
   530→   * which means that changes made to the cloned handle can be sensibly merged back
   531→   * into the original.
   532→   *
   533→   * Any peers this `Repo` is connected to for whom `sharePolicy` returns `true` will
   534→   * be notified of the newly created DocHandle.
   535→   *
   536→   */
   537→  clone<T>(clonedHandle: DocHandle<T>) {
   538→    if (!clonedHandle.isReady()) {
   539→      throw new Error(
   540→        `Cloned handle is not yet in ready state.
   541→        (Try await handle.whenReady() first.)`
   542→      )
   543→    }
   544→
   545→    const sourceDoc = clonedHandle.doc()
   546→    const handle = this.create<T>()
   547→
   548→    handle.update(() => {
   549→      // we replace the document with the new cloned one
   550→      return Automerge.clone(sourceDoc)
   551→    })
   552→
   553→    return handle
   554→  }
   555→
   556→  findWithProgress<T>(
   557→    id: AnyDocumentId,
   558→    options: AbortOptions = {}
   559→  ): FindProgressWithMethods<T> | FindProgress<T> {
   560→    const { signal } = options
   561→    const { documentId, heads } = isValidAutomergeUrl(id)
   562→      ? parseAutomergeUrl(id)
   563→      : { documentId: interpretAsDocumentId(id), heads: undefined }
   564→
   565→    // Check handle cache first - return plain FindStep for terminal states
   566→    if (this.#handleCache[documentId]) {
   567→      const handle = this.#handleCache[documentId]
   568→      if (handle.state === UNAVAILABLE) {
   569→        const result = {
   570→          state: "unavailable" as const,
   571→          error: new Error(`Document ${id} is unavailable`),
   572→          handle,
   573→        }
   574→        return result
   575→      }
   576→      if (handle.state === DELETED) {
   577→        const result = {
   578→          state: "failed" as const,
   579→          error: new Error(`Document ${id} was deleted`),
   580→          handle,
   581→        }
   582→        return result
   583→      }
   584→      if (handle.state === READY) {
   585→        const result = {
   586→          state: "ready" as const,
   587→          handle: heads ? handle.view(heads) : handle,
   588→        }
   589→        return result
   590→      }
   591→    }
   592→
   593→    // Check progress cache for any existing signal
   594→    const cachedProgress = this.#progressCache[documentId]
   595→    if (cachedProgress) {
   596→      const handle = this.#handleCache[documentId]
   597→      // Return cached progress if we have a handle and it's either in a terminal state or loading
   598→      if (
   599→        handle &&
   600→        (handle.state === READY ||
   601→          handle.state === UNAVAILABLE ||
   602→          handle.state === DELETED ||
   603→          handle.state === "loading")
   604→      ) {
   605→        return cachedProgress as FindProgressWithMethods<T>
   606→      }
   607→    }
   608→
   609→    const handle = this.#getHandle<T>({ documentId })
   610→    const initial = {
   611→      state: "loading" as const,
   612→      progress: 0,
   613→      handle,
   614→    }
   615→
   616→    // Create a new progress signal
   617→    const progressSignal = {
   618→      subscribers: new Set<(progress: FindProgress<T>) => void>(),
   619→      currentProgress: undefined as FindProgress<T> | undefined,
   620→      notify: (progress: FindProgress<T>) => {
   621→        progressSignal.currentProgress = progress
   622→        progressSignal.subscribers.forEach(callback => callback(progress))
   623→        // Cache all states, not just terminal ones
   624→        this.#progressCache[documentId] = progress
   625→      },
   626→      peek: () => progressSignal.currentProgress || initial,
   627→      subscribe: (callback: (progress: FindProgress<T>) => void) => {
   628→        progressSignal.subscribers.add(callback)
   629→        return () => progressSignal.subscribers.delete(callback)
   630→      },
   631→    }
   632→
   633→    progressSignal.notify(initial)
   634→
   635→    // Start the loading process
   636→    void this.#loadDocumentWithProgress(
   637→      id,
   638→      documentId,
   639→      handle,
   640→      progressSignal,
   641→      signal ? abortable(new Promise(() => {}), signal) : new Promise(() => {})
   642→    )
   643→
   644→    const result = {
   645→      ...initial,
   646→      peek: progressSignal.peek,
   647→      subscribe: progressSignal.subscribe,
   648→    }
   649→    this.#progressCache[documentId] = result
   650→    return result
   651→  }
   652→
   653→  async #loadDocumentWithProgress<T>(
   654→    id: AnyDocumentId,
   655→    documentId: DocumentId,
   656→    handle: DocHandle<T>,
   657→    progressSignal: {
   658→      notify: (progress: FindProgress<T>) => void
   659→    },
   660→    abortPromise: Promise<never>
   661→  ) {
   662→    try {
   663→      progressSignal.notify({
   664→        state: "loading" as const,
   665→        progress: 25,
   666→        handle,
   667→      })
   668→
   669→      const loadingPromise = await (this.storageSubsystem
   670→        ? this.storageSubsystem.loadDoc(handle.documentId)
   671→        : Promise.resolve(null))
   672→
   673→      const loadedDoc = await Promise.race([loadingPromise, abortPromise])
   674→
   675→      if (loadedDoc) {
   676→        handle.update(() => loadedDoc as Automerge.Doc<T>)
   677→        handle.doneLoading()
   678→        progressSignal.notify({
   679→          state: "loading" as const,
   680→          progress: 50,
   681→          handle,
   682→        })
   683→      } else {
   684→        await Promise.race([this.networkSubsystem.whenReady(), abortPromise])
   685→        handle.request()
   686→        progressSignal.notify({
   687→          state: "loading" as const,
   688→          progress: 75,
   689→          handle,
   690→        })
   691→      }
   692→
   693→      this.#registerHandleWithSubsystems(handle)
   694→
   695→      await Promise.race([handle.whenReady([READY, UNAVAILABLE]), abortPromise])
   696→
   697→      if (handle.state === UNAVAILABLE) {
   698→        const unavailableProgress = {
   699→          state: "unavailable" as const,
   700→          handle,
   701→        }
   702→        progressSignal.notify(unavailableProgress)
   703→        return
   704→      }
   705→      if (handle.state === DELETED) {
   706→        throw new Error(`Document ${id} was deleted`)
   707→      }
   708→
   709→      progressSignal.notify({ state: "ready" as const, handle })
   710→    } catch (error) {
   711→      progressSignal.notify({
   712→        state: "failed" as const,
   713→        error:
   714→          // In most JS environments DOMException extends Error, but not always, in some environments it's a separate type.
   715→          // Some Node.js DOM polyfills do not always extend the Error
   716→          // Jsdom polyfill doesn't extend Error, whereas happy-dom does.
   717→          error instanceof Error || error instanceof DOMException
   718→            ? error
   719→            : new Error(String(error)),
   720→        handle: this.#getHandle<T>({ documentId }),
   721→      })
   722→    }
   723→  }

   725→  async find<T>(
   726→    id: AnyDocumentId,
   727→    options: RepoFindOptions & AbortOptions = {}
   728→  ): Promise<DocHandle<T>> {
   729→    const { allowableStates = ["ready"], signal } = options
   730→
   731→    // Check if already aborted
   732→    if (signal?.aborted) {
   733→      throw new AbortError()
   734→    }
   735→
   736→    const progress = this.findWithProgress<T>(id, { signal })
   737→
   738→    if ("subscribe" in progress) {
   739→      this.#registerHandleWithSubsystems(progress.handle)
   740→      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   741→        const unsubscribe = progress.subscribe(state => {
   742→          if (allowableStates.includes(state.handle.state)) {
   743→            unsubscribe()
   744→            resolve(state.handle)
   745→          } else if (state.state === "unavailable") {
   746→            unsubscribe()
   747→            reject(new Error(`Document ${id} is unavailable`))
   748→          } else if (state.state === "failed") {
   749→            unsubscribe()
   750→            reject(state.error)
   751→          }
   752→        })
   753→      })
   754→    } else {
   755→      if (progress.handle.state === READY) {
   756→        return progress.handle
   757→      }
   758→      // If the handle isn't ready, wait for it and then return it
   759→      await progress.handle.whenReady([READY, UNAVAILABLE])
   760→      if (
   761→        progress.handle.state === "unavailable" &&
   762→        !allowableStates.includes(UNAVAILABLE)
   763→      ) {
   764→        throw new Error(`Document ${id} is unavailable`)
   765→      }
   766→      return progress.handle
   767→    }
   768→  }

   770→  /**
   771→   * Loads a document without waiting for ready state
   772→   */
   773→  async #loadDocument<T>(documentId: DocumentId): Promise<DocHandle<T>> {
   774→    // If we have the handle cached, return it
   775→    if (this.#handleCache[documentId]) {
   776→      return this.#handleCache[documentId]
   777→    }
   778→
   779→    // If we don't already have the handle, make an empty one and try loading it
   780→    const handle = this.#getHandle<T>({ documentId })
   781→    const loadedDoc = await (this.storageSubsystem
   782→      ? this.storageSubsystem.loadDoc(handle.documentId)
   783→      : Promise.resolve(null))
   784→
   785→    if (loadedDoc) {
   786→      // We need to cast this to <T> because loadDoc operates in <unknowns>.
   787→      // This is really where we ought to be validating the input matches <T>.
   788→      handle.update(() => loadedDoc as Automerge.Doc<T>)
   789→      handle.doneLoading()
   790→    } else {
   791→      // Because the network subsystem might still be booting up, we wait
   792→      // here so that we don't immediately give up loading because we're still
   793→      // making our initial connection to a sync server.
   794→      await this.networkSubsystem.whenReady()
   795→      handle.request()
   796→    }
   797→
   798→    this.#registerHandleWithSubsystems(handle)
   799→    return handle
   800→  }

   802→  /**
   803→   * Retrieves a document by id. It gets data from the local system, but also emits a `document`
   804→   * event to advertise interest in the document.
   805→   */
   806→  async findClassic<T>(
   807→    /** The url or documentId of the handle to retrieve */
   808→    id: AnyDocumentId,
   809→    options: RepoFindOptions & AbortOptions = {}
   810→  ): Promise<DocHandle<T>> {
   811→    const documentId = interpretAsDocumentId(id)
   812→    const { allowableStates, signal } = options
   813→
   814→    return abortable(
   815→      (async () => {
   816→        const handle = await this.#loadDocument<T>(documentId)
   817→        if (!allowableStates) {
   818→          await handle.whenReady([READY, UNAVAILABLE])
   819→          if (handle.state === UNAVAILABLE && !signal?.aborted) {
   820→            throw new Error(`Document ${id} is unavailable`)
   821→          }
   822→        }
   823→        return handle
   824→      })(),
   825→      signal
   826→    )
   827→  }

   829→  delete(
   830→    /** The url or documentId of the handle to delete */
   831→    id: AnyDocumentId
   832→  ) {
   833→    const documentId = interpretAsDocumentId(id)
   834→
   835→    const handle = this.#getHandle({ documentId })
   836→    handle.delete()
   837→
   838→    delete this.#handleCache[documentId]
   839→    delete this.#progressCache[documentId]
   840→    delete this.#saveFns[documentId]
   841→    this.emit("delete-document", { documentId })

   844→  /**
   845→   * Exports a document to a binary format.
   846→   * @param id - The url or documentId of the handle to export
   847→   *
   848→   * @returns Promise<Uint8Array | undefined> - A Promise containing the binary document,
   849→   * or undefined if the document is unavailable.
   850→   */
   851→  async export(id: AnyDocumentId): Promise<Uint8Array | undefined> {
   852→    const documentId = interpretAsDocumentId(id)

   854→    const handle = await this.find(documentId)
   855→    const doc = handle.doc()
   856→    return Automerge.save(doc)

   859→  /**
   860→   * Imports document binary into the repo.
   861→   * @param binary - The binary to import
   862→   * @param args - Optional argument specifying what document ID to import into,
   863→   *              if at all possible avoid using this, see the remarks below
   864→   *
   865→   * @remarks
   866→   * If no document ID is provided, a new document will be created. When
   867→   * specifying the document ID it is important to ensure that two documents using
   868→   * the same ID share the same history - i.e. don't create a document with the
   869→   * same ID on unrelated processes that have never communicated with each
   870→   * other. If you need to ship around a bunch of documents with their IDs
   871→   * consider using the `automerge-repo-bundles` package which provides a
   872→   * serialization format for documents and IDs and handles the boilerplate of
   873→   * importing and exporting these bundles.
   874→   */
   875→  import<T>(binary: Uint8Array, args?: { docId?: DocumentId }): DocHandle<T> {
   876→    const docId = args?.docId
   877→    if (docId != null) {
   878→      const handle = this.#getHandle<T>({ documentId: docId })
   879→      handle.update(doc => {
   880→        return Automerge.loadIncremental(doc, binary)
   881→      })
   882→      this.#registerHandleWithSubsystems(handle)
   883→      return handle
   884→    } else {
   885→      const doc = Automerge.load<T>(binary)
   886→      const handle = this.create<T>()
   887→      handle.update(() => {
   888→        return Automerge.clone(doc)
   889→      })
   890→
   891→      return handle
   892→    }
   893→  }

   914→  /**
   915→   * Writes Documents to a disk.
   916→   * @hidden this API is experimental and may change.
   917→   * @param documents - if provided, only writes the specified documents.
   918→   * @returns Promise<void>
   919→   */
   920→  async flush(documents?: DocumentId[]): Promise<void> {
   921→    if (!this.storageSubsystem) {
   922→      return
   923→    }
   924→    const handles = documents
   925→      ? documents.map(id => this.#handleCache[id])
   926→      : Object.values(this.#handleCache)
   927→    await Promise.all(
   928→      handles.map(async handle => {
   929→        return this.storageSubsystem!.saveDoc(handle.documentId, handle.doc())
   930→      })
   931→    )
   932→  }

   934→  /**
   935→   * Removes a DocHandle from the handleCache.
   936→   * @hidden this API is experimental and may change.
   937→   * @param documentId - documentId of the DocHandle to remove from handleCache, if present in cache.
   938→   * @returns Promise<void>
   939→   */
   940→  async removeFromCache(documentId: DocumentId) {
   941→    if (!this.#handleCache[documentId]) {
   942→      this.#log(
   943→        `WARN: removeFromCache called but handle not found in handleCache for documentId: ${documentId}`
   944→      )
   945→      return
   946→    }
   947→    const handle = this.#getHandle({ documentId })
   948→    await handle.whenReady([READY, UNLOADED, DELETED, UNAVAILABLE])
   949→    const doc = handle.doc()
   950→    // because this is an internal-ish function, we'll be extra careful about undefined docs here
   951→    if (doc) {
   952→      if (handle.isReady()) {
   953→        handle.unload()
   954→      } else {
   955→        this.#log(
   956→          `WARN: removeFromCache called but handle for documentId: ${documentId} in unexpected state: ${handle.state}`
   957→        )
   958→      }
   959→      delete this.#handleCache[documentId]
   960→      delete this.#progressCache[documentId]
   961→      delete this.#saveFns[documentId]
   962→      this.synchronizer.removeDocument(documentId)
   963→    } else {
   964→      this.#log(
   965→        `WARN: removeFromCache called but doc undefined for documentId: ${documentId}`
   966→      )
   967→    }
   968→  }

   970→  shutdown(): Promise<void> {
   971→    this.networkSubsystem.adapters.forEach(adapter => {
   972→      adapter.disconnect()
   973→    })
   974→    return this.flush()
   975→  }

  1001→   * Normal peers typically share generously with everyone (meaning we sync all our documents with
  1002→   * all peers). A server only syncs documents that a peer explicitly requests by ID.
  1003→   */

  1005→
  1006→  /**
  1007→   * Whether to share documents with other peers. By default we announce new
  1008→   * documents to everyone and allow everyone access to documents, see the
  1009→   * documentation for {@link ShareConfig} to override this
  1010→   *
  1011→   * Note that this is currently an experimental API and will very likely change
  1012→   * without a major release.
  1013→   * @experimental

  1015→  shareConfig?: ShareConfig
  1016→

  1021→

  1023→   * A list of automerge URLs which should never be loaded regardless of what
  1024→   * messages are received or what the share policy is. This is useful to avoid

  1027→  denylist?: AutomergeUrl[]

  1029→  /**
  1030→   * The debounce rate in milliseconds for saving documents. Defaults to 100ms.
  1031→   */
  1032→  saveDebounceRate?: number
  1033→
  1034→  // This is hidden for now because it's an experimental API, mostly here in order
  1035→  // for keyhive to be able to control the ID generation

  1038→   */

  1042→/** A function that determines whether we should share a document with a peer
  1043→ *
  1044→ * @remarks
  1045→ * This function is called by the {@link Repo} every time a new document is created

    23→/**
    24→ * A DocHandle is a wrapper around a single Automerge document that lets us listen for changes and
    25→ * notify the network and storage of new changes.
    26→ *
    27→ * @remarks
    28→ * A `DocHandle` represents a document which is being managed by a {@link Repo}. You shouldn't ever
    29→ * instantiate this yourself. To obtain `DocHandle` use {@link Repo.find} or {@link Repo.create}.
    30→ *

    32→ * {@link DocHandle.changeAt}. These methods will notify the `Repo` that some change has occured and

   183→  /**

   185→   *
   186→   * @param awaitStates - HandleState or HandleStates to wait for
   187→   * @param signal - Optional AbortSignal to cancel the waiting operation
   188→   */
   189→  #statePromise(
   190→    awaitStates: HandleState | HandleState[],
   191→    options?: AbortOptions
   192→  ) {
   193→    const awaitStatesArray = Array.isArray(awaitStates)
   194→      ? awaitStates
   195→      : [awaitStates]
   196→    return waitFor(
   197→      this.#machine,
   198→      s => awaitStatesArray.some(state => s.matches(state)),

   204→  /**

   207→   * This is necessary instead of directly calling

   209→   * want to catch any exceptions that the callback might throw, then rethrow
   210→   * them after the state machine has processed the update.
   211→   */
   212→  #sendUpdate(callback: (doc: A.Doc<T>) => A.Doc<T>) {
   213→    // This is kind of awkward. we have to pass the callback to xstate and wait for it to run it.
   214→    // We're relying here on the fact that xstate runs everything synchronously, so by the time
   215→    // `send` returns we know that the callback will have been run and so `thrownException`  will
   216→    // be set if the callback threw an error.
   217→    let thrownException: null | Error = null
   218→    this.#machine.send({
   219→      type: UPDATE,
   220→      payload: {
   221→        callback: doc => {

   226→            return doc
   227→          }
   228→        },
   229→      },
   230→    })

   233→      throw thrownException

   237→  /**

   246→      encodeHeads(beforeHeads)

   251→      const patches = A.diff(after, beforeHeads, afterHeads)

   254→          handle: this,
   255→          doc: after,
   256→          patches,
   257→          // TODO: pass along the source (load/change/network)
   258→          patchInfo: { before, after, source: "change" },
   259→        })
   260→      }

   263→      if (!this.isReady()) this.#machine.send({ type: DOC_READY })

   266→  }

   268→  // PUBLIC

   354→  /**

   396→  /**
   397→   * Returns an array of all past "heads" for the document in topological order.
   398→   *
   399→   * @remarks
   400→   * A point-in-time in an automerge document is an *array* of heads since there may be
   401→   * concurrent edits. This API just returns a topologically sorted history of all edits
   402→   * so every previous entry will be (in some sense) before later ones, but the set of all possible
   403→   * history views would be quite large under concurrency (every thing in each branch against each other).
   404→   * There might be a clever way to think about this, but we haven't found it yet, so for now at least
   405→   * we present a single traversable view which excludes concurrency.
   406→   * @returns UrlHeads[] - The individual heads for every change in the document. Each item is a tagged string[1].

   419→  /**

   422→   * undefined if the object hasn't finished loading.
   423→   *
   424→   * @remarks
   425→   * Note that our Typescript types do not consider change over time and the current version
   426→   * of Automerge doesn't check types at runtime, so if you go back to an old set of heads
   427→   * that doesn't match the heads here, Typescript will not save you.
   428→   *
   429→   * @argument heads - The heads to view the document at. See history().
   430→   * @returns DocHandle<T> at the time of `heads`
   431→   */
   432→  view(heads: UrlHeads): DocHandle<T> {
   433→    if (!this.isReady()) {
   434→      throw new Error(
   435→        `DocHandle#${this.documentId} is not ready. Check \`handle.isReady()\` before calling view().`
   436→      )
   437→    }
   438→
   439→    // Create a cache key from the heads
   440→    const cacheKey = JSON.stringify(heads)
   441→
   442→    // Check if we have a cached handle for these heads
   443→    const cachedHandle = this.#viewCache.get(cacheKey)
   444→    if (cachedHandle) {
   445→      return cachedHandle
   446→    }
   447→
   448→    // Create a new handle with the same documentId but fixed heads
   449→    const handle = new DocHandle<T>(this.documentId, {
   450→      heads,
   451→      timeoutDelay: this.#timeoutDelay,
   452→    })
   453→    handle.update(() => A.clone(this.#doc))
   454→    handle.doneLoading()
   455→
   456→    // Store in cache
   457→    this.#viewCache.set(cacheKey, handle)
   458→
   459→    return handle
   460→  }
   461→
   462→  /**
   463→   * Returns a set of Patch operations that will move a materialized document from one state to another
   464→   * if applied.
   465→   *
   466→   * @remarks
   467→   * We allow specifying either:
   468→   * - Two sets of heads to compare directly
   469→   * - A single set of heads to compare against our current heads
   470→   * - Another DocHandle to compare against (which must share history with this document)
   471→   *
   472→   * @throws Error if the documents don't share history or if either document is not ready
   473→   * @returns Automerge patches that go from one document state to the other
   474→   */
   475→  diff(first: UrlHeads | DocHandle<T>, second?: UrlHeads): A.Patch[] {
   476→    if (!this.isReady()) {
   477→      throw new Error(
   478→        `DocHandle#${this.documentId} is not ready. Check \`handle.isReady()\` before calling diff().`
   479→      )
   480→    }
   481→
   482→    const doc = this.#doc
   483→    if (!doc) throw new Error("Document not available")
   484→
   485→    // If first argument is a DocHandle
   486→    if (first instanceof DocHandle) {
   487→      if (!first.isReady()) {
   488→        throw new Error("Cannot diff against a handle that isn't ready")
   489→      }
   490→      const otherHeads = first.heads()
   491→      if (!otherHeads) throw new Error("Other document's heads not available")
   492→
   493→      // Create a temporary merged doc to verify shared history and compute diff
   494→      const mergedDoc = A.merge(A.clone(doc), first.doc()!)
   495→      // Use the merged doc to compute the diff
   496→      return A.diff(
   497→        mergedDoc,
   498→        decodeHeads(this.heads()!),
   499→        decodeHeads(otherHeads)
   500→      )
   501→    }
   502→
   503→    // Otherwise treat as heads
   504→    const from = second ? first : ((this.heads() || []) as UrlHeads)
   505→    const to = second ? second : first
   506→    return A.diff(doc, decodeHeads(from), decodeHeads(to))
   507→  }
   508→
   509→  /**
   510→   * `metadata(head?)` allows you to look at the metadata for a change
   511→   * this can be used to build history graphs to find commit messages and edit times.
   512→   * this interface.
   513→   *
   514→   * @remarks
   515→   * I'm really not convinced this is the right way to surface this information so
   516→   * I'm leaving this API "hidden".
   517→   *
   518→   * @hidden
   519→   */
   520→  metadata(change?: string): A.DecodedChange | undefined {
   521→    if (!this.isReady()) {
   522→      return undefined
   523→    }
   524→
   525→    if (!change) {
   526→      change = this.heads()![0]
   527→    }
   528→    // we return undefined instead of null by convention in this API
   529→    return (
   530→      A.inspectChange(this.#doc, decodeHeads([change] as UrlHeads)[0]) ||
   531→      undefined
   532→    )
   533→  }
   534→
   535→  /**
   536→   * `update` is called any time we have a new document state; could be
   537→   * from a local change, a remote change, or a new document from storage.
   538→   * Does not cause state changes.
   539→   * @hidden
   540→   */
   541→  update(callback: (doc: A.Doc<T>) => A.Doc<T>) {
   542→    this.#sendUpdate(callback)
   543→  }
   544→
   545→  /**
   546→   * `doneLoading` is called by the repo after it decides it has all the changes
   547→   * it's going to get during setup. This might mean it was created locally,
   548→   * or that it was loaded from storage, or that it was received from a peer.
   549→   */
   550→  doneLoading() {
   551→    this.#machine.send({ type: DOC_READY })
   552→  }
   553→
   554→  /**
   555→   * Called by the repo when a doc handle changes or we receive new remote heads.
   556→   * @hidden
   557→   */
   558→  setSyncInfo(storageId: StorageId, syncInfo: SyncInfo) {
   559→    this.#syncInfoByStorageId[storageId] = syncInfo
   560→    this.emit("remote-heads", {
   561→      storageId,
   562→      heads: syncInfo.lastHeads,
   563→      timestamp: syncInfo.lastSyncTimestamp,
   564→    })
   565→  }
   566→
   567→  /** Returns the heads of the storageId.
   568→   *
   569→   * @deprecated Use getSyncInfo instead.
   570→   */
   571→  getRemoteHeads(storageId: StorageId): UrlHeads | undefined {
   572→    return this.#syncInfoByStorageId[storageId]?.lastHeads
   573→  }
   574→
   575→  /** Returns the heads and the timestamp of the last update for the storageId. */
   576→  getSyncInfo(storageId: StorageId): SyncInfo | undefined {
   577→    return this.#syncInfoByStorageId[storageId]
   578→  }
   579→
   580→  /**
   581→   * All changes to an Automerge document should be made through this method.
   582→   * Inside the callback, the document should be treated as mutable: all edits will be recorded
   583→   * using a Proxy and translated into operations as part of a single recorded "change".
   584→   *
   585→   * Note that assignment via ES6 spread operators will result in *replacing* the object
   586→   * instead of mutating it which will prevent clean merges. This may be what you want, but
   587→   * `doc.foo = { ...doc.foo, bar: "baz" }` is not equivalent to `doc.foo.bar = "baz"`.
   588→   *
   589→   * Local changes will be stored (by the StorageSubsystem) and synchronized (by the
   590→   * DocSynchronizer) to any peers you are sharing it with.
   591→   *
   592→   * @param callback - A function that takes the current document and mutates it.
   593→   *
   594→   */
   595→  change(callback: A.ChangeFn<T>, options: A.ChangeOptions<T> = {}) {
   596→    if (!this.isReady()) {
   597→      throw new Error(
   598→        `DocHandle#${this.documentId} is in ${this.state} and not ready. Check \`handle.isReady()\` before accessing the document.`
   599→      )
   600→    }
   601→
   602→    if (this.#fixedHeads) {
   603→      throw new Error(
   604→        `DocHandle#${this.documentId} is in view-only mode at specific heads. Use clone() to create a new document from this state.`
   605→      )
   606→    }
   607→
   608→    this.#sendUpdate(doc => A.change(doc, options, callback))
   609→  }
   610→  /**
   611→   * Makes a change as if the document were at `heads`.
   612→   *
   613→   * @returns A set of heads representing the concurrent change that was made.
   614→   */
   615→  changeAt(
   616→    heads: UrlHeads,
   617→    callback: A.ChangeFn<T>,
   618→    options: A.ChangeOptions<T> = {}
   619→  ): UrlHeads | undefined {
   620→    if (!this.isReady()) {
   621→      throw new Error(
   622→        `DocHandle#${this.documentId} is not ready. Check \`handle.isReady()\` before accessing the document.`
   623→      )
   624→    }
   625→    if (this.#fixedHeads) {
   626→      throw new Error(
   627→        `DocHandle#${this.documentId} is in view-only mode at specific heads. Use clone() to create a new document from this state.`
   628→      )
   629→    }
   630→
   631→    let resultHeads: UrlHeads | undefined = undefined
   632→    this.#sendUpdate(doc => {
   633→      const result = A.changeAt(doc, decodeHeads(heads), options, callback)
   634→      resultHeads = result.newHeads ? encodeHeads(result.newHeads) : undefined
   635→      return result.newDoc
   636→    })
   637→
   638→    // the callback above will always run before we get here, so this should always contain the new heads
   639→    return resultHeads

   642→  /**

   644→   * edited unless we are viewing a particular point in time.
   645→   *
   646→   * @remarks It is technically possible to back-date changes using changeAt(),
   647→   *          but we block it for usability reasons when viewing a particular point in time.

   656→  /**
   657→   * Merges another document into this document. Any peers we are sharing changes with will be
   658→   * notified of the changes resulting from the merge.
   659→   *
   660→   * @returns the merged document.
   661→   *
   662→   * @throws if either document is not ready or if `otherHandle` is unavailable.
   663→   */
   664→  merge(
   665→    /** the handle of the document to merge into this one */
   666→    otherHandle: DocHandle<T>
   667→  ) {
   668→    if (!this.isReady() || !otherHandle.isReady()) {
   669→      throw new Error("Both handles must be ready to merge")
   670→    }
   671→    if (this.#fixedHeads) {
   672→      throw new Error(
   673→        `DocHandle#${this.documentId} is in view-only mode at specific heads. Use clone() to create a new document from this state.`

   675→    }
   676→    const mergingDoc = otherHandle.doc()
   677→
   678→    this.update(doc => {
   679→      return A.merge(doc, mergingDoc)

   681→  }
   682→
   683→  /**
   684→   * Updates the internal state machine to mark the document unavailable.
   685→   * @hidden
   686→   */
   687→  unavailable() {
   688→    this.#machine.send({ type: DOC_UNAVAILABLE })
   689→  }
   690→
   691→  /**
   692→   * Called by the repo either when the document is not found in storage.
   693→   * @hidden
   694→   * */
   695→  request() {
   696→    if (this.#state === "loading") this.#machine.send({ type: REQUEST })
   697→  }
   698→
   699→  /** Called by the repo to free memory used by the document. */
   700→  unload() {
   701→    this.#machine.send({ type: UNLOAD })
   702→  }
   703→
   704→  /** Called by the repo to reuse an unloaded handle. */
   705→  reload() {
   706→    this.#machine.send({ type: RELOAD })
   707→  }
   708→
   709→  /** Called by the repo when the document is deleted. */
   710→  delete() {
   711→    this.#machine.send({ type: DELETE })
   712→  }
   713→
   714→  /**
   715→   * Sends an arbitrary ephemeral message out to all reachable peers who would receive sync messages
   716→   * from you. It has no guarantee of delivery, and is not persisted to the underlying automerge doc
   717→   * in any way. Messages will have a sending PeerId but this is *not* a useful user identifier (a
   718→   * user could have multiple tabs open and would appear as multiple PeerIds). Every message source
   719→   * must have a unique PeerId.
   720→   */
   721→  broadcast(message: unknown) {
   722→    this.emit("ephemeral-message-outbound", {
   723→      handle: this,
   724→      data: new Uint8Array(encode(message)),
   725→    })
   726→  }
   727→
   728→  metrics(): { numOps: number; numChanges: number } {
   729→    return A.stats(this.#doc)
   730→  }
   731→
   732→  /**
   733→   * Create a ref to a location in this document.
   734→   *
   735→   * Returns the same ref instance for the same path, ensuring referential equality.
   736→   *
   737→   * @experimental This API is experimental and may change in future versions.
   738→   *
   739→   * @example
   740→   * ```ts
   741→   * const titleRef = handle.ref('todos', 0, 'title');
   742→   * titleRef.value(); // string | undefined
   743→   *
   744→   * // Same ref instance is returned for same path
   745→   * const sameRef = handle.ref('todos', 0, 'title');
   746→   * titleRef === sameRef; // true
   747→   * ```
   748→   */
   749→  ref<TPath extends readonly PathInput[]>(
   750→    ...segments: [...TPath]
   751→  ): Ref<InferRefType<T, TPath>> {
   752→    const cacheKey = this.#pathToCacheKey(segments)
   753→    const existingRef = this.#refCache.get(cacheKey)?.deref()
   754→
   755→    if (existingRef) {
   756→      return existingRef as Ref<InferRefType<T, TPath>>
   757→    }
   758→
   759→    // Create new ref and cache it
   760→    const newRef = new RefImpl<T, TPath>(this, segments as [...TPath])
   761→    this.#refCache.set(cacheKey, new WeakRef(newRef))
   762→
   763→    return newRef as Ref<InferRefType<T, TPath>>
   764→  }
   765→
   766→  /**
   767→   * Create a stable cache key from path segments.
   768→   * Serializes the path to a string for comparison.
   769→   */
   770→  #pathToCacheKey(segments: readonly PathInput[]): string {
   771→    return segments
   772→      .map(seg => {
   773→        if (typeof seg === "string") return `s:${seg}`
   774→        if (typeof seg === "number") return `n:${seg}`
   775→        if (typeof seg === "object" && seg !== null) {
   776→          // Pattern or CursorMarker
   777→          return `o:${JSON.stringify(seg)}`
   778→        }
   779→        return `?:${String(seg)}`
   780→      })
   781→      .join("/")
   782→  }
   783→}

1→/** Throttle
     2→ * Returns a function with a built in throttle timer that runs after `delay` ms.
     3→ *
     4→ * This function differs from a conventional `throttle` in that it ensures the final
     5→ * call will also execute and delays sending the first one until `delay` ms to allow
     6→ * additional work to accumulate.
     7→ *
     8→ * Here's a diagram:
     9→ *
    10→ * calls +----++++++-----++----
    11→ * dlay  ^--v ^--v^--v   ^--v
    12→ * execs ---+----+---+------+--
    13→ *
    14→ * The goal in this design is to create batches of changes without flooding
    15→ * communication or storage systems while still feeling responsive.
    16→ * (By default we communicate at 10hz / every 100ms.)
    17→ *
    18→ * Note that the args go inside the parameter and you should be careful not to
    19→ * recreate the function on each usage. (In React, see useMemo().)
    20→ *
    21→ *
    22→ * Example usage:
    23→ * const callback = throttle((ev) => { doSomethingExpensiveOrOccasional() }, 100)
    24→ * target.addEventListener('frequent-event', callback);
    25→ *
    26→ */
    27→
    28→export const throttle = <F extends (...args: Parameters<F>) => ReturnType<F>>(
    29→  fn: F,
    30→  delay: number
    31→) => {
    32→  let lastCall = Date.now()
    33→  let wait
    34→  let timeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>
    35→  return function (...args: Parameters<F>) {
    36→    wait = lastCall + delay - Date.now()
    37→    clearTimeout(timeout)
    38→    timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    39→      fn(...args)
    40→      lastCall = Date.now()
    41→    }, wait)
    42→  }
    43→}
    44→

   138→
   139→    const syncState = this.#syncStates[peerId]
   140→    if (syncState) {
   141→      callback(syncState)
   142→      return
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    let pendingCallbacks = this.#pendingSyncStateCallbacks[peerId]
   146→    if (!pendingCallbacks) {
   147→      this.#onLoadSyncState(peerId)
   148→        .then(syncState => {
   149→          this.#initSyncState(peerId, syncState ?? A.initSyncState())
   150→        })
   151→        .catch(err => {
   152→          this.#log(`Error loading sync state for ${peerId}: ${err}`)
   153→        })
   154→      pendingCallbacks = this.#pendingSyncStateCallbacks[peerId] = []
   155→    }
   156→
   157→    pendingCallbacks.push(callback)
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  #addPeer(peerId: PeerId) {
   161→    if (!this.#peers.includes(peerId)) {
   162→      this.#peers.push(peerId)
   163→      this.emit("open-doc", { documentId: this.documentId, peerId })
   164→    }
   165→  }
   166→
   167→  #initSyncState(peerId: PeerId, syncState: A.SyncState) {
   168→    const pendingCallbacks = this.#pendingSyncStateCallbacks[peerId]
   169→    if (pendingCallbacks) {
   170→      for (const callback of pendingCallbacks) {
   171→        callback(syncState)
   172→      }
   173→    }
   174→
   175→    delete this.#pendingSyncStateCallbacks[peerId]
   176→
   177→    this.#syncStates[peerId] = syncState
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  #setSyncState(peerId: PeerId, syncState: A.SyncState) {
   181→    this.#syncStates[peerId] = syncState
   182→
   183→    this.emit("sync-state", {
   184→      peerId,
   185→      syncState,
   186→      documentId: this.#handle.documentId,
   187→    })
   188→  }
   189→
   190→  #sendSyncMessage(peerId: PeerId, doc: A.Doc<unknown>) {
   191→    this.#log(`sendSyncMessage ->${peerId}`)
   192→
   193→    this.#withSyncState(peerId, syncState => {
   194→      const start = performance.now()
   195→      const [newSyncState, message] = A.generateSyncMessage(doc, syncState)
   196→      const end = performance.now()
   197→      this.emit("metrics", {
   198→        type: "generate-sync-message",
   199→        documentId: this.#handle.documentId,
   200→        durationMillis: end - start,
   201→        forPeer: peerId,
   202→      })
   203→
   204→      this.#setSyncState(peerId, newSyncState)
   205→      if (message) {
   206→        const isNew = A.getHeads(doc).length === 0
   207→
   208→        if (
   209→          !this.#handle.isReady() &&
   210→          isNew &&
   211→          newSyncState.sharedHeads.length === 0 &&
   212→          !Object.values(this.#peerDocumentStatuses).includes("has") &&
   213→          this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId] === "unknown"
   214→        ) {
   215→          // we don't have the document (or access to it), so we request it
   216→          this.emit("message", {
   217→            type: "request",
   218→            targetId: peerId,
   219→            documentId: this.#handle.documentId,
   220→            data: message,
   221→          } as RequestMessage)
   222→        } else {
   223→          this.emit("message", {
   224→            type: "sync",
   225→            targetId: peerId,
   226→            data: message,
   227→            documentId: this.#handle.documentId,
   228→          } as SyncMessage)
   229→        }
   230→
   231→        // if we have sent heads, then the peer now has or will have the document
   232→        if (!isNew) {
   233→          this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId] = "has"
   234→        }
   235→      }
   236→    })
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  /// PUBLIC
   240→
   241→  hasPeer(peerId: PeerId) {
   242→    return this.#peers.includes(peerId)
   243→  }
   244→
   245→  async beginSync(peerIds: PeerId[]) {
   246→    void this.#handle
   247→      .whenReady([READY, REQUESTING, UNAVAILABLE])
   248→      .then(() => {
   249→        this.#syncStarted = true
   250→        this.#checkDocUnavailable()
   251→      })
   252→      .catch(e => {
   253→        console.log("caught whenready", e)
   254→        this.#syncStarted = true
   255→        this.#checkDocUnavailable()
   256→      })
   257→
   258→    const peersWithDocument = this.#peers.some(peerId => {
   259→      return this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId] == "has"
   260→    })
   261→
   262→    if (peersWithDocument) {
   263→      await this.#handle.whenReady()
   264→    }
   265→
   266→    peerIds.forEach(peerId => {
   267→      this.#withSyncState(peerId, syncState => {
   268→        // HACK: if we have a sync state already, we round-trip it through the encoding system to make
   269→        // sure state is preserved. This prevents an infinite loop caused by failed attempts to send
   270→        // messages during disconnection.
   271→        // TODO: cover that case with a test and remove this hack
   272→        const reparsedSyncState = A.decodeSyncState(
   273→          A.encodeSyncState(syncState)
   274→        )
   275→        this.#setSyncState(peerId, reparsedSyncState)
   276→
   277→        // At this point if we don't have anything in our storage, we need to use an empty doc to sync
   278→        // with; but we don't want to surface that state to the front end
   279→        this.#handle
   280→          .whenReady([READY, REQUESTING, UNAVAILABLE])
   281→          .then(() => {
   282→            const doc = this.#handle.isReady()
   283→              ? this.#handle.doc()
   284→              : A.init<unknown>()
   285→
   286→            const noPeersWithDocument = peerIds.every(
   287→              peerId =>
   288→                this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId] in ["unavailable", "wants"]
   289→            )
   290→
   291→            const wasUnavailable = doc === undefined
   292→            if (wasUnavailable && noPeersWithDocument) {
   293→              return
   294→            }
   295→
   296→            // If the doc is unavailable we still need a blank document to generate
   297→            // the sync message from
   298→            this.#sendSyncMessage(peerId, doc ?? A.init<unknown>())
   299→          })
   300→          .catch(err => {
   301→            this.#log(`Error loading doc for ${peerId}: ${err}`)
   302→          })
   303→      })
   304→    })
   305→  }
   306→
   307→  endSync(peerId: PeerId) {
   308→    this.#log(`removing peer ${peerId}`)
   309→    this.#peers = this.#peers.filter(p => p !== peerId)
   310→    delete this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId]
   311→    this.#checkDocUnavailable()
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  receiveMessage(message: RepoMessage) {
   315→    switch (message.type) {
   316→      case "sync":
   317→      case "request":
   318→        this.receiveSyncMessage(message)
   319→        break
   320→      case "ephemeral":
   321→        this.receiveEphemeralMessage(message)
   322→        break
   323→      case "doc-unavailable":
   324→        this.#peerDocumentStatuses[message.senderId] = "unavailable"
   325→        this.#checkDocUnavailable()
   326→        break
   327→      default:
   328→        throw new Error(`unknown message type: ${message}`)
   329→    }
   330→  }
   331→
   332→  receiveEphemeralMessage(message: EphemeralMessage) {
   333→    if (message.documentId !== this.#handle.documentId)
   334→      throw new Error(`channelId doesn't match documentId`)
   335→
   336→    const { senderId, data } = message
   337→
   338→    const contents = decode(new Uint8Array(data))
   339→
   340→    this.#handle.emit("ephemeral-message", {
   341→      handle: this.#handle,
   342→      senderId,
   343→      message: contents,
   344→    })
   345→
   346→    this.#peers.forEach(peerId => {
   347→      if (peerId === senderId) return
   348→      this.emit("message", {
   349→        ...message,
   350→        targetId: peerId,
   351→      })
   352→    })
   353→  }
   354→
   355→  receiveSyncMessage(message: SyncMessage | RequestMessage) {
   356→    if (message.documentId !== this.#handle.documentId)
   357→      throw new Error(`channelId doesn't match documentId`)
   358→
   359→    // We need to block receiving the syncMessages until we've checked local storage
   360→    if (!this.#handle.inState([READY, REQUESTING, UNAVAILABLE])) {
   361→      this.#pendingSyncMessages.push({ message, received: new Date() })
   362→      return
   363→    }
   364→
   365→    this.#processAllPendingSyncMessages()
   366→    this.#processSyncMessage(message)
   367→  }
   368→
   369→  #processSyncMessage(message: SyncMessage | RequestMessage) {
   370→    if (isRequestMessage(message)) {
   371→      this.#peerDocumentStatuses[message.senderId] = "wants"
   372→    }
   373→
   374→    this.#checkDocUnavailable()
   375→
   376→    // if the message has heads, then the peer has the document
   377→    if (A.decodeSyncMessage(message.data).heads.length > 0) {
   378→      this.#peerDocumentStatuses[message.senderId] = "has"
   379→    }
   380→
   381→    this.#withSyncState(message.senderId, syncState => {
   382→      this.#handle.update(doc => {
   383→        const start = performance.now()
   384→
   385→        const [newDoc, newSyncState] = A.receiveSyncMessage(
   386→          doc,
   387→          syncState,
   388→          message.data
   389→        )
   390→        const end = performance.now()
   391→        this.emit("metrics", {
   392→          type: "receive-sync-message",
   393→          documentId: this.#handle.documentId,
   394→          durationMillis: end - start,
   395→          fromPeer: message.senderId,
   396→          ...A.stats(doc),
   397→        })
   398→
   399→        this.#setSyncState(message.senderId, newSyncState)
   400→
   401→        // respond to just this peer (as required)
   402→        this.#sendSyncMessage(message.senderId, doc)
   403→        return newDoc
   404→      })
   405→
   406→      this.#checkDocUnavailable()
   407→    })
   408→  }
   409→
   410→  #checkDocUnavailable() {
   411→    // if we know none of the peers have the document, tell all our peers that we don't either
   412→    if (
   413→      this.#syncStarted &&
   414→      this.#handle.inState([REQUESTING, UNAVAILABLE]) &&
   415→      this.#peers.every(
   416→        peerId =>
   417→          this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId] === "unavailable" ||
   418→          this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId] === "wants"
   419→      )
   420→    ) {
   421→      this.#peers
   422→        .filter(peerId => this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId] === "wants")
   423→        .forEach(peerId => {
   424→          // Transition the peer to unavailable so that we don't send it a doc-unavailable
   425→          // message every time we run #checkDocUnavailable
   426→          this.#peerDocumentStatuses[peerId] = "unavailable"
   427→          const message: MessageContents<DocumentUnavailableMessage> = {
   428→            type: "doc-unavailable",
   429→            documentId: this.#handle.documentId,
   430→            targetId: peerId,
   431→          }
   432→          this.emit("message", message)
   433→        })
   434→
   435→      this.#handle.unavailable()
   436→    }
   437→  }
   438→
   439→  #processAllPendingSyncMessages() {
   440→    for (const message of this.#pendingSyncMessages) {
   441→      this.#processSyncMessage(message.message)
   442→    }
   443→
   444→    this.#pendingSyncMessages = []
   445→  }
   446→
   447→  metrics(): { peers: PeerId[]; size: { numOps: number; numChanges: number } } {
   448→    return {
   449→      peers: this.#peers,
   450→      size: this.#handle.metrics(),
   451→    }
   452→  }
